requirements.contract: Arrays, slices, and runtime sequences yield ascending logical indexes independent of storage address.
The producer does not advance while the current item is outstanding; item release or transfer is required before the next pull.
Maps yield their declared deterministic logical order independent of insertion layout, hash bucket order, process seed, or address.
At most one item is outstanding per iterator, including nested and fallible iterator cases.
Iteration v1 prefetches zero items and retains no hidden future item or future item cleanup obligation.
Each iteration step performs exactly one consumer-requested next operation and yields at most one item.
A static user iterator declares a deterministic order as part of its implementation contract.
Text yields Unicode scalar values in source order, never bytes or host code units.

negative_cases.expected: proof rejected when outstanding item count exceeds one
proof rejected when prefetch count exceeds zero
proof rejected when the producer advances before current-item release
